text.en:
The barangays of Bokiawan, Nanggulunan, Hapao and Loboong all in the Municipality of Tinoc,
Province of Ifugao, are hereby transferred to the Municipality of Hungduan, same province.

The Commission on Elections shall conduct and supervise the holding of the plebiscite in the
areas affected within ninety days from the approval of this Act, the expenses of which shall be charged to
local funds.

All acts or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: January 19, 1983
